description: This file contains a modified implementation of an equality check function for testing purposes, including handling of typed nils, within the githubv4mock package.

methods.name: objectsAreEqualValues
methods.description: Compares two values for equality, with special handling for numeric types and type conversion.

methods.name: objectsAreEqual
methods.description: Determines if two objects are considered equal, with special handling for typed nils and byte slices.

methods.name: isNumericType
